tasks.title: SSE events for the console: scope builds and changes, facts joining scopes, handoffs, audit
tasks.note: Audited every scopes route against PRD #15/#19: scope.stage (measured times), scope.updated (built / rule_changed / fact_joined / fact_left), principal.changed (added / tier_changed / agent_created / agent_deleted), handoff.served, quarantine.released and audit.logged were already emitted with their audit rows. Gap closed: POST /api/quarantine wrote its audit row but emitted nothing — it now emits quarantine.flagged (relay for lane B workers kept). No new event types; plain SSE unchanged. Tests assert event + audit row per route.

tasks.title: Scope builder: exclusions in code → Moss candidates → Jev yes/no → scope, with living updates
tasks.note: Deny-by-default enforced in code before any search: excluded groups and labels leave the pool before Moss or Jev see anything (allowedByRule in server/src/scopes.ts), scopes are fixed fact-id lists, agents are capped at their creator, living updates keep scopes current (4576d07). Expiring clearances were cut by the scopes PRD #14 — access changes are rule edits, not timed grants.

tasks.title: Handoff: search inside the scope → Jev relevance → token budget → audit
tasks.note: server/src/scopes.ts runHandoff: fixed scope → retriever inside the scope's groups with in-code fact-id re-check → inject-nothing judge() check → one batched Jev relevance ask → budget cut in code → audit row with exactly the facts sent. Judge/retriever failures degrade to profile-only, never a refusal or leak. Offline providers are the labelled keyword retriever + fake judge (Moss id-filter and Jev creds still open under A4/Q2).

tasks.title: Calibrate the scope-build and handoff thresholds on live Jev
tasks.note: Calibrated on live Jev (demo world, one run, Sat 10/24): EXCLUDE_GROUP 0.2→0.6, EXCLUDE_FACT 0.3→0.45, IN_SCOPE 0.7→0.5, RELEVANT 0.7→0.6, NEEDS_CONTEXT stays 0.5; measured ranges sit next to each value in shared/src/types/judge.ts. Live result: Dollar Bill's scope 11 facts (public, research, his desk; zero deal), Axe's 18 (12 deal). Small scopes (≤40 facts) are judged whole, so the keyword stub no longer drops paraphrases. One world, one run: re-check on the benchmark.
